newsitem.title: USA: MAXXAM may issue $100 million in 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: MAXXAM may issue $100 million in 144A debt.

text.p: MAXXAM Inc on Tuesday said its new subsidiary MAXXAM Group Holdings Inc (MGHI) may raise $100 million through a Rule 144A debt offering.

Proceeds of the offering would be loaned to MAXXAM to redeem approximately $17.6 million outstanding principal amount of its 12-1/2 percent Subordinated Debentures due December 15, 1999 and about $25 million outstanding principal amount of its 14 percent Senior Subordinated Reset Notes due May 20, 2000.
The loan would also pay accrued interest on the debt.
The remaining proceeds would be earmarked for general corporate purposes, including possible repurchases of its existing common stock, MAXXAM said.

The MGHI debt would not be registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and could not be offered or sold in the United States without registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements.
MAXXAM's primary industries are aluminum, forest products, and real estate.
